headline_marked: Loan default: [[Supreme Court bars Aslam Chowdhury]] from taking oath as Chattogram-4 MP
headline: Loan default: Supreme Court bars Aslam Chowdhury from taking oath as Chattogram-4 MP
summary: The Appellate Division has scrapped the candidacy of the BNP candidate after he was found to be a loan defaulter.
details: The Supreme Court's Appellate Division has barred BNP candidate Aslam Chowdhury from taking office as the Member of Parliament for the Chattogram-4 seat.
The court's decision, delivered on Tuesday, was based on the fact that Aslam Chowdhury is a loan defaulter.
A four-member bench led by Chief Justice Zubayer Rahman Chowdhury scrapped the candidacy and suspended the election results for the seat.
During the hearing, Aslam Chowdhury was represented by lawyers Miftah Uddin Chowdhury and AM Mahbub Uddin Khokon.
The opposing side was represented by lawyer Mohammad Shishir Manir and Barrister ASM Shahriar Kabir on behalf of the Jamaat-e-Islami candidate, Anwar Siddique.
caption:
A loan default has cost a winning candidate his seat in Parliament.

The Supreme Court's Appellate Division has barred BNP candidate Aslam Chowdhury from taking office as the Member of Parliament for the Chattogram-4 seat.

The court's decision, delivered on Tuesday, was based on the fact that Aslam Chowdhury is a loan defaulter.

A four-member bench led by Chief Justice Zubayer Rahman Chowdhury scrapped the candidacy and suspended the election results for the seat.

During the hearing, Aslam Chowdhury was represented by lawyers Miftah Uddin Chowdhury and AM Mahbub Uddin Khokon.

The opposing side was represented by lawyer Mohammad Shishir Manir and Barrister ASM Shahriar Kabir on behalf of the Jamaat-e-Islami candidate, Anwar Siddique.

#Bangladesh #SupremeCourt #Chattogram #Politics #BNP

Source: bdnews24.com, Dhaka Tribune, Somoy News, Jamuna TV

headline_marked: 1,719 dead as [[Venezuela earthquake death toll rises]]
headline: 1,719 dead as Venezuela earthquake death toll rises
summary: Over 5,000 people have been injured and tens of thousands remain missing following the devastating quakes.
details: The death toll from devastating earthquakes that struck Venezuela five days ago has risen to at least 1,719, according to National Assembly president Jorge Rodriguez.
In addition to the fatalities, Rodriguez reported that 5,034 people were injured in the disaster.
The scale of the tragedy is immense, with tens of thousands of people still reported missing across the affected regions.
Survivors of the quakes have expressed frustration and decried the slow arrival of aid to the hardest-hit areas.
Amidst the crisis, political figure Maria Machado has announced her intention to return to Venezuela to provide assistance to the quake victims.
caption:
1,719 dead and tens of thousands missing. Venezuela is reeling from devastating earthquakes.

The death toll from devastating earthquakes that struck Venezuela five days ago has risen to at least 1,719, according to National Assembly president Jorge Rodriguez.

In addition to the fatalities, Rodriguez reported that 5,034 people were injured in the disaster.

The scale of the tragedy is immense, with tens of thousands of people still reported missing across the affected regions.

Survivors of the quakes have expressed frustration and decried the slow arrival of aid to the hardest-hit areas.

Amidst the crisis, political figure Maria Machado has announced her intention to return to Venezuela to provide assistance to the quake victims.
